The explicit quotient F3[t]/(t^6+t+2) is a field, as all 728 nonzero elements are invertible. Independent C++17 field and projective-line enumeration of the actual finite domain recovered 892 rational curve points, 532171 projective points/lines, exact line intersection histogram 0:158760,1:175420,2:158112,4:39879 and all 17 asserted exterior N(P) frequencies summing to 531279. It independently checked N=222 exactly on the 63 F9-rational exterior points; global table confirms exactly 63 such maximizers. No 3-secant occurs, and every exterior projection pencil is basepoint-free degree 4. This is a finite exhaustive computation, unlike extrapolating finite tests to infinitely many field sizes.
